value.signature: fn fmt (& self , formatter : & mut std :: fmt :: Formatter < '_ >) -> std :: fmt :: Result

exception.justification: Justified: Formatting a bounded public error is inherited by its instrumented codec operation; a span here could recurse while recording that error.

review.item_premise: Caller-selected fragment codecs read complete public component bytes under supplied limits and return bounded public refusals. They neither select an evaluator nor establish publication binding.
